name: {s}Defeat Dune Teardrinker in a game of Polymock at Doomlore Shrine.

<c=@warning>[Difficulty: Master]</c> <c=@warning>[Solo Quest]</c> I've arranged a match for you against a particularly vicious opponent. He's the only Charr I've encountered with the patience and skill to learn the game. <c=@Quest>Dune Teardrinker</c> is his name. His pieces are so rare you may never find others like them. Be careful if you win, though. Charr don't take kindly to losing.

Reward:<brx>250 Asura reputation points<brx>Summon Naga Shaman<brx>Aloe Seed Polymock Piece<brx>
